The error occurred while serializing the set, so I will recompute the four lower existing ratings and their exact counts without touching the review IDs.

```python
target_lower_ratings = {
    song_id: existing_ratings[song_id]
    for song_id in target_song_ids
    if song_id in existing_ratings and existing_ratings[song_id] < 5.0
}
rating_summary_lower = {
    'one_star': sum(1 for rating in target_lower_ratings.values() if rating == 1.0),
    'two_star': sum(1 for rating in target_lower_ratings.values() if rating == 2.0),
    'three_star': sum(1 for rating in target_lower_ratings.values() if rating == 3.0),
    'four_star': sum(1 for rating in target_lower_ratings.values() if rating == 4.0)
}
print(rating_summary_lower)
```
